nodes.description: Contract admin address; set to msg.sender in the constructor and used by adminOnly gating.
Array of listed PalPool addresses.
Array of listed PalToken addresses.
Mapping PalToken => PalPool used to resolve pools in deposit/withdraw.
Mapping PalPool => PoolRewardsState (index + blockNumber) holding supply reward state.
Mapping PalPool => reward tokens distributed per block.
Mapping PalPool => user => deposited PalToken amount.
Mapping PalPool => total PalToken amount deposited in the controller.
Mapping user => accrued claimable reward token amount.
Mapping PalPool => borrow reward ratio scaled 1e18.
Mapping PalLoan => frozen borrow reward ratio set at loan creation.
Mapping PalLoan => whether its borrow rewards were already distributed.
Address of the PAL reward token used for reward transfers.
Reentrancy lock flag used by the lock modifier.
Proxy storage slot holding the current implementation target for delegatecall.
External deposit: accrues supply rewards, updates balances, pulls PalTokens via safeTransferFrom.
External withdraw: accrues supply rewards, decreases balances, sends PalTokens via safeTransfer.
External claim: updates user rewards across pools and transfers accrued PAL rewards.
External claim of borrow rewards for a PalLoan, transferring rewards to the borrower.
Internal: recomputes the pool supply reward index from block delta and supply speed.
Internal: accrues pending supply rewards to a user claimable balance.
Admin: withdraws reward tokens held by the controller to a recipient.
Admin: initializes the PalToken/PalPool lists and reward states once.
Admin: updates supply speed, borrow ratio and auto-borrow-reward flag for a pool.
Public: iterates all pools and accrues the user's supply rewards.
View: estimates pending claimable rewards for a user over all pools.
Internal view: computes claimable borrow rewards for a closed PalLoan.
Internal: reads pool borrow data and accrues borrow rewards to the loan borrower.
Internal: freezes the pool borrow ratio onto a new PalLoan.
Admin: accepts a pending implementation on the proxy, enabling delegatecall execution.
Admin: calls withdrawFees on a PalPool to move accrued fees.
View: returns the configured reward token address.
Constructor: assigns the deployer as admin.
Untrusted caller identity used for admin gating, loan ownership and deposit/withdraw attribution.
Untrusted block context (block.number/timestamp) driving reward accrual math.
External token transferFrom call inside deposit, executed while the lock modifier is held.
External token transfer call inside withdraw, executed while the lock modifier is held.
External reward token transfer inside claim, executed while the lock modifier is held.
External reward token transfer inside claimLoanRewards, executed while the lock modifier is held.
External reward token transfer executed by the admin-only withdrawRewardToken.
Reward index arithmetic (mul/div by 1e36 and block delta) inside updateSupplyIndex.
delegatecall fallback in ControllerProxy that forwards calldata to the current implementation.
Address array parameter of setInitialPools describing the pools to list.
PalToken address parameter of deposit, resolved through palTokenToPalPool.
Amount parameter of deposit, validated against the caller balance.
Local variable holding msg.sender inside deposit.
Local variable holding the resolved PalPool address inside deposit.
PalToken address parameter of withdraw, resolved through palTokenToPalPool.
Amount parameter of withdraw, checked against supplierDeposits.
User address parameter of claim whose rewards are accrued and transferred.
User address parameter of updateUserRewards.
Memory copy of the palPools array used while estimating rewards.
Storage pointer to the pool PoolRewardsState inside updateSupplyIndex.

edges.reason: msg.sender determines the depositor account credited in deposit.
msg.sender determines whose supplierDeposits balance is debited in withdraw.
msg.sender-based flow in claim for the supplied user address.
claimLoanRewards requires msg.sender to equal the loan borrower.
setInitialPools is gated by adminOnly using msg.sender.
updatePoolRewards is gated by adminOnly using msg.sender.
withdrawRewardToken is gated by adminOnly using msg.sender.
Constructor sets admin from msg.sender.
Reward index depends on block.number/block delta, a block-context dependency.
deposit invokes the external token transferFrom operation.
withdraw invokes the external token transfer operation.
claim invokes the reward token transfer operation.
claimLoanRewards invokes the reward token transfer operation.
withdrawRewardToken invokes the reward token transfer operation.
updateSupplyIndex performs reward index arithmetic.
Token transferFrom can re-enter deposit before the lock is released.
Token transfer can re-enter withdraw before the lock is released.
Reward token transfer can re-enter claim before the lock is released.
Reward token transfer can re-enter claimLoanRewards before the lock is released.
deposit calls updateSupplyIndex before accruing rewards.
deposit calls accrueSupplyRewards for the depositor.
withdraw calls updateSupplyIndex before accruing rewards.
withdraw calls accrueSupplyRewards for the withdrawer.
claim calls updateUserRewards to accrue all pending rewards.
updateUserRewards updates each pool supply index.
updateUserRewards accrues supply rewards per pool for the user.
claimLoanRewards computes the claimable amount through _calculateLoanRewards.
claimLoanRewards resolves the reward token via rewardToken().
Accepting the implementation on the proxy activates the delegatecall fallback path.
rewardToken() reads rewardTokenAddress.
withdrawRewardToken reads and uses rewardTokenAddress for the transfer.
updateSupplyIndex writes index and blockNumber into supplyRewardState.
accrueSupplyRewards reads the user deposited balance from supplierDeposits.
accrueSupplyRewards increases accruedRewards for the user.
deposit increases supplierDeposits for the user.
withdraw decreases supplierDeposits for the user.
claim reads and resets accruedRewards before transferring.
claimLoanRewards uses accrued reward accounting to pay the borrower.
deposit resolves the PalPool through palTokenToPalPool.
accrueBorrowRewards reads the loan borrow ratio from loansBorrowRatios.
PalToken parameter feeds the pool lookup in deposit.
Amount parameter controls deposits accounting and transfer amount.
PalToken parameter feeds the pool lookup in withdraw.
Amount parameter controls withdraw accounting and transfer amount.
User parameter selects the account whose rewards are claimed.
Pools array parameter is written into palPools and reward states.
User parameter selects whose rewards are accrued.
Local pools array drives the estimation loop.
Local storage pointer is mutated with the new reward index.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter only exists to seed palPools inside setInitialPools.
PalToken parameter is only used for the palTokenToPalPool lookup in deposit.
Amount parameter is only consumed by deposit accounting and transferFrom.
Local user alias is just msg.sender inside deposit.
Local pool alias is resolved and used only within deposit.
PalToken parameter is only used for the palTokenToPalPool lookup in withdraw.
Amount parameter is only consumed by withdraw accounting and transfer.
User parameter is only consumed by claim accrual and transfer.
User parameter is only used to accrue rewards in updateUserRewards.
Local pools copy is a transient array used only in estimateClaimable.
Storage pointer to the pool reward state is local to updateSupplyIndex.
